issues.issue: Whether the respondent is excluded under Article 1F(b) for a serious non-political crime committed in the US
issues.applicant_position: The Minister says the US offences are serious non-political crimes and the respondent should be excluded.
issues.respondent_position: Offences are not serious in Canada; he denies the first incident and admits the second.
issues.result_text: Presumption of seriousness rebutted; the respondent is not excluded under Article 1F(b) or section 98.

issues.issue: Whether the respondent is a Convention refugee on the basis of sexual orientation
issues.applicant_position: The Minister makes no submissions on inclusion or refugee status based on sexual orientation.
issues.result_text: Agrees the respondent is a Convention refugee; the situation for sexual minorities in Haiti has not changed.
